ModMetaData.name: Ketjak's Consumption Rates
ModMetaData.author: Ketjak
ModMetaData.description:
A bottom-row tab showing a live surplus/deficit chart for everything countable in your colony - food, steel, components, medicine, chemfuel and the rest - plus power generated against power used. Each row shows the creation number and the consumption number side by side, with a bar for the net: right of centre for a surplus, left for a deficit, worst first.
Rates are measured from the game itself over a rolling window (an hour by default), not calculated from formulas. A part-grown field counts toward its crop's future numbers at its measured growth speed, so the chart warns before a gap opens rather than only after the field is cut.
Checkboxes in the window let you choose which rows to see, the way the Numbers mod does. Two settings control how often a sample is taken and how long a window of samples is kept; both are preferences, not save data.
Sampling history is saved with the colony, so the chart is not empty again after a reload.
